title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: Ack padding check inverted in from_bytes_for
description:
## Bug: Ack padding bit check is inverted

**File:** `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:323`

**Code:**
```rust
if padding > 7 || (0..padding).any(|i| !get_bit(&data[1..], 2 + WINDOW_SIZE + i)) {
    return Err(FragmentError::MalformedAck);
}
```

Per RFC 8724, padding bits in an ACK bitmap MUST be zero. The check should reject padding bits that are 1 (non-zero). However, the `!get_bit(...)` negation inverts the check: it now rejects padding bits that are 0 (correct padding) and accepts padding bits that are 1 (incorrect padding).

**Fix:** Remove the `!` to match the original (correct) behavior:
```rust
if padding > 7 || (0..padding).any(|i| get_bit(&data[1..], 2 + WINDOW_SIZE + i)) {
```

**Impact:** Malicious or malformed ACK packets with non-zero padding bits would be accepted as valid. Correctly-formed ACKs with zero padding bits would be incorrectly rejected.
